main_text.l: VIgesimo quinto Martij post meridiem Brabantiæ
Ordines, videlicet Prælati, Nobiles, Legatique Ci-
vitatum in Consilium status ad Gubernatricem acciti,
ibi illis ipsa significavit, intellexisse se, certam adversus
provincias conspirationem esse præ manibus, unde nisi
tempori occurreretur, haud exigua mala timeantur: ut
ipsi igitur, quos non fugeret, quanti interesset, patriæ
salia impediri, pro se quisque diligenter attenderent, &
Celsitudinem suam, si quid inaudissent certiorem facere-
nt. Quandoquidem autem intellexerat hanc advers-
us inquisitionem videri coniurationem, aut eo saltem
alio prætextuque velatam, missa ad quatuor primarias
Civitates Apostilla declararat, nec esse nec fuisse Regis
ut suam voluntatem, alicuius in Brabantiam inquisi-
tionis inducendæ. Ad quæ Ordines actis Celsitudini
ire pro sollicitudine curaque sua gratiis, omnem operam
ac diligentiam obtulerunt. Post hæc Antverpiensium
Legatos allocuta, docuit exteros quosdam e conjuratis

page.notes: The first line of the main text is a fragment continuing from the previous page; the left edge is cropped so the first letters of many lines are partly cut off. The opening word "VIgesimo" has a large decorative initial V; read as "Vigesimo". Several words in the body are uncertain due to the faded scan and cut edge, notably "perpenss" (perpendens?), "inaudissent" and "Antverpiensium" (long s rendered as s in the printed original). Long s is given as s throughout per convention.
